newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Energy Equity in new Indonesia deals.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Energy Equity in new Indonesia deals.

text.p: Perth-based Energy Equity Corp Ltd (EEC) said it was negotiating with Indonesia's state-owned oil company, Pertamina, for two technical assistance contracts in gas exploration areas South Sumatra.
The negotiations were aimed at EEC building a second power station in Indonesia, EEC managing director Maurice Brand said.
The two contracts are for areas 50 km southwest of EEC's currently-producing Harimau oil/gas field where the US$9 million Singa 1 exploration well will be spudded early next year.
Known as Talang Babat and Lahat, the areas were a potential fuel source for power plants through gas sales to Pertamina, EEC said in a statement.
EEC has a 20 percent free carried interest in Singa 1 which is targeting a one trillion cubic feet gas accumulation in the proven Batu Raja formation in South Sumatra, Brand said.
EEC also said it had recently officially signed in Jakarta for its US$179 million financing facility for the Sengkang gas and power project in South Sulawesi.
